name: mirage
text:
v1.0.118 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.118
What changed for lightness: (1) the phone downloads your wallet history once, then only the last 3 days, merged into its cache; (2) days older than 35 days are kept as one daily-numbers record (profit, staked, wins, losses) worked out from Novig's money and cached permanently, and their individual bets are removed; (3) the Tracker's money overlay is computed once per new file, not on every bet save; (4) the wallet files are checked once a minute instead of every 6 seconds. Daily profit, charts and all-time totals keep including the old days. Note: stats that need single bets (by league, kind, CLV) now cover only the recent 35 days.
